title: Papildu dokumenti (LETTER OF AUTHORISATION)
text: LETTER OF AUTHORIZATION I, Andris Kulbergs, Prime Minister , hereby certify that Kārlis Purgailis, Minister for Finance, is authorized to confirm on behalf of the Republic of Latvia the participation of the Republic of Latvia in the establishment of Defence, Security and Resilience Bank and to sign the relevant Articles of Agreement.  In witness whereof, I have signed these presents and caused the official seal to be affixed hereunder.
